headline: 7 killed as bus collides head-on with autorickshaw in Mymensingh
summary: The victims, including a child, died after a bus crushed a CNG-run autorickshaw near the Gondropa bypass on Friday afternoon.
details: Seven people, including a child, were killed after a bus crushed a CNG-run autorickshaw in Mymensingh.
The accident occurred near the Gondropa bypass in Mymensingh city around 1:15pm on Friday.
According to Muhammad Shibirul Islam, chief of Kotwali Model Police Station, the collision was a head-on crash.
The impact was so severe that the front sections of both the autorickshaw and the bus were mangled.
Local authorities and police arrived at the scene to manage the situation and recover the bodies.
caption:
7 people, including a child, killed in a horrific head-on collision in Mymensingh.

Seven people, including a child, were killed after a bus crushed a CNG-run autorickshaw in Mymensingh.

The accident occurred near the Gondropa bypass in Mymensingh city around 1:15pm on Friday.

According to Muhammad Shibirul Islam, chief of Kotwali Model Police Station, the collision was a head-on crash.

The impact was so severe that the front sections of both the autorickshaw and the bus were mangled.

Local authorities and police arrived at the scene to manage the situation and recover the bodies.

headline_marked: Nightclub photos of [[Bangladesh players emerge after 9-2 loss]] to Indonesia
headline: Nightclub photos of Bangladesh players emerge after 9-2 loss to Indonesia
summary: Photos showing national team players Saad Uddin and Sohel Rana Jr at a club in Jakarta surfaced on social media shortly after a crushing defeat.
details: Bangladesh suffered a devastating 9-2 defeat against Indonesia in the FIFA ASEAN Cup in Jakarta on Thursday, marking their heaviest loss in three years.
Hours after the match, photos allegedly showing players Saad Uddin and Sohel Rana Jr at the H Club nightclub surfaced on X (formerly Twitter), posted by an Indonesian user.
The user claimed the players approached her and invited her to watch the match, though the posts were later deleted after going viral.
Team manager Amirul Islam Babu stated that players were instructed to return to their rooms after dinner before their flight home the next morning.
Babu added that while they cannot monitor players' doors all night, the team's disciplinary committee will take action if it is proven the players went out.
The ASEAN Cup campaign ended in disappointment for Bangladesh, with three consecutive losses against Malaysia (3-0), Singapore (1-0), and Indonesia (9-2).
caption:
A 9-2 humiliation and then nightclub photos? Bangladesh national team players are under fire.

Bangladesh suffered a devastating 9-2 defeat against Indonesia in the FIFA ASEAN Cup in Jakarta on Thursday, marking their heaviest loss in three years.

Hours after the match, photos allegedly showing players Saad Uddin and Sohel Rana Jr at the H Club nightclub surfaced on X (formerly Twitter), posted by an Indonesian user.

The user claimed the players approached her and invited her to watch the match, though the posts were later deleted after going viral.

Team manager Amirul Islam Babu stated that players were instructed to return to their rooms after dinner before their flight home the next morning.

Babu added that while they cannot monitor players' doors all night, the team's disciplinary committee will take action if it is proven the players went out.

The ASEAN Cup campaign ended in disappointment for Bangladesh, with three consecutive losses against Malaysia (3-0), Singapore (1-0), and Indonesia (9-2).
